inputs.checklistItemText: Equipment pad installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes lacks required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details, or bollards not spaced to allow equipment door opening
inputs.question: Are any of the five transformer pads located within 4 feet of parking areas, driveways, or vehicle circulation routes? If yes, are bollards or protective posts shown around those pads, and if so, what are their specifications?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a two-part presence/feature question: (1) whether transformer pads exist within 4 feet of vehicle routes, and (2) whether bollards are visible and what their specs are. This is progressive verification—identifying which pads need bollards before measuring bollard spacing or diameter. The actual clearance measurement (4-foot distance) and bollard specification compliance (4-inch diameter, spacing) are secondary to the current presence and identification task.
